name: 1Panel
summary: Open-source Linux server management panel with a one-click app store, Docker, website hosting and AI agent management.
description: Web-based control panel for Linux servers: host monitoring, file, database and container management, one-click WordPress/SSL deployment, WAF and backups, and a curated app store (187 apps). Adds AI management for Ollama, agents and MCP servers; OSS edition is free, Pro ($80/yr or $200 perpetual) and Enterprise editions add multi-node management, advanced security and governance.
